snippet.title: Send Them to Hell - Demo Release Trailer
snippet.description:
Today we released our demo today.

In the first hour, we broke 200 downloads, and the wishlists are climbing.

At launch, Send Them to Hell will feature:
-5 Biomes
-Full Co-op Campaign
-Endless Mode
-An Entire Dungeon Floor-Based Mode
-Dedicated Weekly Challenges
-Leaderboards
-Unique Skins
-Skin Creator
-120+ Items
-In-Game Wiki

And a whole lot more

It's worth the try. I promise. ❤️

Steam:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/4922730/Send_Them_to_Hell/

Discord:
https://discord.gg/vMxMkZY79F
